lesson: A snapshot taken when the strategy stops is not the end state of a run: read the cache again after the node has shut down, because a fill in the residual-event window otherwise records a pass.
source: bootstrap review 2026-11-17, before the first commit

lesson: Send the stop-time cancel unconditionally: an order sent but not yet acknowledged is not open in the cache, so a cancel gated on open orders leaves it working at the venue.
source: bootstrap review 2026-11-17, before the first commit

lesson: Every mode that prices an order from a quote requires both sides, an uncrossed quote and a recent time, because the adapter builds quotes from separately cached sides.
source: bootstrap review 2026-11-17, before the first commit

lesson: A command filter that exempts some programs splits on every shell separator, a single ampersand included, and treats socket paths and loopback hosts as not exempt.
source: bootstrap review 2026-11-17, before the first commit

lesson: A guard names the modules and folders the tree really has, and matches a protected folder with or without a trailing slash, or a renamed module and a recursive read pass it.
source: bootstrap review 2026-11-17, before the first commit

lesson: A lock that enforces one client per Gateway lives at a path that no environment variable can move, and so do folders whose records must stay outside the checkout.
source: bootstrap review 2026-11-17, before the first commit

lesson: A process scan counts a process whose arguments run the module, not any command line that mentions its name: the mention refuses on a search and misses an import.
source: bootstrap review 2026-11-17, before the first commit

lesson: A comparison against the records of the venue is made only inside the window the venue was asked for; outside it the record says not compared and does not fail.
source: bootstrap review 2026-11-17, before the first commit

lesson: A guard for every test is installed when conftest is imported, not by a fixture, so that imports during collection are covered as well.
source: bootstrap review 2026-11-17, before the first commit

lesson: A test of a derived value feeds an input that differs from the default, or a hard-coded value passes it.
source: bootstrap review 2026-11-17, before the first commit

lesson: A scan for order calls lists every routine in the stubs of the engine that sends, changes or cancels an order, its exit routines included, and is read again when the engine moves.
source: bootstrap review 2026-11-17, before the first commit

lesson: An identifier that the venue can report in two forms is matched by every stable key the venue carries back, here the venue order id or the client order id.
source: bootstrap review 2026-11-17, before the first commit

lesson: A rule about what a shell command reads or writes looks at the words and redirection targets of the command, split with a real lexer, because matching the raw text both misses bare names and refuses prose.
source: bootstrap review 2026-11-17, round 2, before the first commit

lesson: A value kept from a checked quote keeps the time of that quote and is checked again at each later use, or an expired price is used after the check that admitted it.
source: bootstrap review 2026-11-17, round 2, before the first commit

lesson: A scan of process command lines keeps the real argument boundaries and parses the options of the interpreter to its entry point, because splitting arguments on white space turns a search pattern into an invocation.
source: bootstrap review 2026-11-17, round 2, before the first commit

lesson: Isolation that a fixture provides does not cover the import of a test module: put the stand-in in place when conftest is imported, and test it from a test that requests no fixture.
source: bootstrap review 2026-11-17, round 2, before the first commit

lesson: A test that a value is passed on varies that value, or a literal equal to the default passes it.
source: bootstrap review 2026-11-17, round 2, before the first commit

lesson: A guard that reads a shell command treats every word as a possible file unless it stands where a program takes a pattern or a message, and keeps quoted lines, here-documents and substitutions as the shell would run them.
